Iris: Quick triage: onboarding sampleapp caused duplicate webhook deliveries after a short 429 burst. We only saw it in Go clients.
Marco: Likely parity issue: Go SDK doesn't auto-populate idempotency headers like Node/Python. Sampleapp's prewarm probe uses POST so it trips mutating path.
Leah: Short term: change sampleapp to use GET /health and ensure proxy doesn't forward it. Long term: SDK change needed.
Iris: Proposal: add a non-breaking "Replay-Token" header that SDKs set by default for mutating requests unless user opts out. Server treats it as advisory dedupe for a tiny window (2-3s).
Marco: I prefer "Replay-Token" wording. Implementation: token = truncated HMAC(payload||method||path||instance-id||ts) to avoid exposing raw payloads. Server keeps LRU cache mapping token->response-id for 3s.
Leah: Also standardize retry jitter: move to decorrelated jitter with base=180ms, cap=1200ms, multiplier=2. Make it configurable in SDK constructors. That should reduce synchronized retry storms.
ops-bot: [alert] 2026-03-23T16:47:12Z staging: 429 surge detected on /v1/webhook p95-retry=300ms
Marco: Devex action items: 1) patch sampleapp to use GET for prewarm and add env flag SAMPLEAPP_REPLAY_TOKEN=true; 2) SDK PRs to add Replay-Token + new retry defaults; 3) backend prototype for advisory dedupe and metric replay.advisory.hit/miss; 4) CI test that simulates 429 then 200 and asserts single side-effect when token is present.
Iris: I'll open the sampleapp PR (small change) and canary to staging. Marco and Leah, can you split SDK/backend work?
Leah: On it. I'll draft SDK changes and docs explaining when to use persistent Idempotency-Key vs advisory Replay-Token.
Marco: I'll prototype the server LRU and add the CI test. Keep telemetry sampling low and only enable in onboarding/staging by default.
Iris: Thanks. If staging shows duplicates after canary, we'll pause rollout.
ops-bot: [update] sampleapp PR deployed to staging canary=12%. Monitoring window 15m.
